title: Toggle filter component audit
purpose: Audit toggle as a binary filter component with explicit on/off semantics.
objective: Define toggle anatomy, switch track/thumb, label behavior, on/off states, layout, accessibility, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: switch track, thumb, label, checked state, disabled state, inline/row layouts, accessibility, and QA scenario. Out of scope: checkbox, radio, chips, swatch, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current toggle render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A toggle audit sheet exists with binary contracts and controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: State matrix and responsive behavior are documented.
acceptance_criteria: No plugin source changes are made.
